long_biography.plain_text:
Nomikos has spent her career in the shipping enterprise founded in Greece by Anastasios and Angele Nomikos. She served as president from 1976 and now chairs its board, overseeing a family-owned group engaged in commercial ship owning, ship management and freight services. The business developed from coastal shipping into a dry-bulk fleet and later added container-ship management.

Her work has also crossed into corporate governance and public-interest organisations. She has held board positions in real-estate and industrial-minerals companies and served with groups concerned with transparency, social support, culture and health. Educated in economics and business administration, she later completed Harvard Business School's President's Program in Leadership, pairing a long shipping career with broader governance experience.
